description: This file defines the interface DepositAccountWritePlatformService, which declares methods related to deposit account operations such as activating, depositing, withdrawing, closing, transferring, and charging for savings accounts. It is part of the savings service layer in the Fineract project.

classes.name: DepositAccountWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining deposit account operations for savings accounts, including activation, deposit, withdrawal, transfer, charging, and closing functionalities.

methods.name: activateFDAccount
methods.description: Activates a fixed deposit savings account based on the provided command data.

methods.name: activateRDAccount
methods.description: Activates a recurring deposit savings account based on the provided command data.

methods.name: updateDepositAmountForRDAccount
methods.description: Updates the deposit amount for a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: depositToFDAccount
methods.description: Deposits an amount into a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: depositToRDAccount
methods.description: Deposits an amount into a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: withdrawal
methods.description: Performs withdrawal from an account, considering deposit account type.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest for a specific savings account based on account type.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Posts calculated interest to a savings account.

methods.name: undoFDTransaction
methods.description: Undoes a fixed deposit transaction.

methods.name: undoRDTransaction
methods.description: Undoes a recurring deposit transaction.

methods.name: adjustFDTransaction
methods.description: Adjusts details of a fixed deposit transaction.

methods.name: adjustRDTransaction
methods.description: Adjusts details of a recurring deposit transaction.

methods.name: closeFDAccount
methods.description: Closes a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: closeRDAccount
methods.description: Closes a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: prematureCloseFDAccount
methods.description: Permanently closes a fixed deposit account before maturity.

methods.name: prematureCloseRDAccount
methods.description: Permanently closes a recurring deposit account before maturity.

methods.name: initiateSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer of savings to another account.

methods.name: withdrawSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Completes a savings transfer withdrawal.

methods.name: rejectSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Rejects a pending savings transfer.

methods.name: acceptSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Accepts a savings transfer, recording related office and staff details.

methods.name: addSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Adds a charge to a savings account.

methods.name: updateSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Updates details of a savings account charge.

methods.name: deleteSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Deletes a specific savings account charge.

methods.name: waiveCharge
methods.description: Waives a specified charge on a savings account.

methods.name: payCharge
methods.description: Records payment of a specific charge.

methods.name: applyChargeDue
methods.description: Applies charges that are due on an account.

methods.name: updateMaturityDetails
methods.description: Updates maturity related details for a deposit account.

methods.name: mandatorySavingsAccountDeposit
methods.description: Performs a mandatory deposit transaction for a savings account, given transaction details.
